died.name: Thomas, 2nd Earl of Lancaster
died.cause: before beheading for treason against his cousin, Edward II of England
died.last_words: King of heaven, do thou have mercy on me, for the king of earth hath forsaken me.

died.name: Jean-Baptiste Lully
died.cause: The French composer died of a gangrenous abscess after accidentally piercing his foot with a staff while he was vigorously conducting a Te Deum. It was customary at that time to conduct by banging a staff on the floor. He refused to have his leg amputated so he could still dance.

died.name: Jonathan Edwards
died.cause: when someone lamented what his loss would mean to the church and to the College of New Jersey
died.last_words: Trust in God and you need not fear.

died.name: Stephen Decatur
died.cause: mortally wounded in duel with James Barron
died.last_words: I am mortally wounded ... I think.

died.name: Johann Wolfgang von Goethe
died.last_words: Do open the shutter in the bed-room, in order that more light may enter.

died.name: Hedley Vicars
died.cause: killed in action in the Crimean War

died.name: Herbert George Columbine
died.cause: to fellow soldiers after holding off the enemy for four hours with a Vickers machine gun at Hervilly Wood, France, during World War I

born.name: August Hermann Francke
born.cause: when his wife asked if his Savior was still with him

born.name: Chico Marx
born.cause: giving his wife Mary humorous instructions for his funeral
born.last_words: Remember, Honey, don't forget what I told you. Put in my coffin a deck of cards, a mashie niblick, and a pretty blonde.
